models_evaluated: 20 representative MLLMs (proprietary, open-source general-purpose, and medical-domain models; individual names not listed in text)

links.outcome: MLLM performance on OCT understanding benchmark across perception, cognition, reasoning
links.effect: Current models remain substantially short of reliable OCT understanding; neither medical-domain adaptation nor increased model scale consistently improves performance across capability levels.
links.quote: Experimental results demonstrate that current models remain substantially short of reliable OCT understanding.

screen.reason: The study introduces and evaluates 20 multimodal LLMs on OCT-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for optical coherence tomography image understanding across clinical reasoning and diagnostic tasks.
